name: Claude Desktop
limitations: Browser sign-in callbacks reach the default Claude instance; use the guided snapshot sign-in.
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is experimental and is not officially documented.

verifiedOn.by: ai-multi-instance (upstream report, not local account QA)

seo.title: Multiple Claude Desktop Instances on Windows
seo.description: Launch separate Claude Desktop profiles with isolated app data and a per-profile LOCALAPPDATA. See sign-in guidance and limitations.
seo.intro: Claude Desktop profiles use a separate user-data directory and LOCALAPPDATA so each launch has its own state. Windows sends browser sign-in callbacks to the main app, so new accounts need a guided snapshot sign-in.
